response.justification: Bogdan possesses over 15 years of software engineering experience, primarily in full-stack, web, and microservices development. However, he lacks the specialized hardware and AI accelerator expertise essential for this Principal Performance Architect role. His resume shows no background in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD, or deep-learning workload optimization, making him fundamentally unsuited for the hardware-software co-design and infrastructure optimization tasks required.
strengths: Over 15 years of extensive software engineering experience, including Staff and Founder level roles.
Strong background in high-performance microservices and low-latency application development.
Demonstrated leadership in software craftsmanship, including TDD, CI/CD, and system architecture.
concerns: Zero demonstrated experience with SoC and IP modeling or hardware-software co-design.
Lacks expertise in deep neural network (DNN) training, inference optimization, and GPU architecture.
No background in hardware-level performance bottleneck analysis or SIMD/MIMD architectures.
